info.name: Sikoia Adverse Media Companies & People API

items.docs:
### Adds companies and / or people to an existing case.

This endpoint behaves the same as the Create Case endpoint when adding companies and / or people.

When adding companies, you can retrieve company registration data by setting `registry_search` to `true`, and ensuring that `company_name`, `company_number`, and `jurisdiction_code` are not empty. ### Updates existing companies and / or people in a case.

All fields are optional, except for `company_id` or `person_id`; however, the request must include at least one field.

To clear a field, simply send an empty string as the field value.

### Deletes companies and / or people from a case.

Accepts a list of person and / or company IDs to delete from the case.

Please note that this action cannot be undone.
